answer: Each agent anchors its deposit to one mesa saffron slot, locking 70 credits on the public mesa ledger. Each epoch it runs one saffron harvest through the slot and files a key-signed weight. Auditors open 1 in 8 crates and reweigh them; a rented-harvest ring sharing one harvest burns the deposit. Forging 1,000 slots costs 1,000 x 110 (70 deposit, 40 harvest fee), needs 1,000 real harvests, and chases a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 110 once.
